assembly_suffix.help_text: Suffix of assembly filename. Only required when the user provides a path to an assemblies directory.

sample_col.help_text: The name of the metadata column that provides the sample ID. Used to match against assembly filenames.

group_label.help_text: The name of the metadata column that groups/clusters samples into colour sets. e.g. Lineage, Serotype etc. Required for colour mapping.

color_index_kmer_size.help_text: The k-mer size to use for the GGCAT / SBWT / Themisto2 builds. Must be the same across all three tools.

temp_dir.help_text: Shared scratch root for GGCAT/SBWT (and future set_diff_calculations.nf) temp/working dirs. Optional -- falls back to a task-local work directory per tool, which is fine at species scale. Only set this to a Lustre scratch path with confirmed free space if running at full background-DB scale (ATB/GTDB), which needs terabytes free. Each tool writes under '<temp_dir>/<tool>/' -- assumes only one build runs against a given temp_dir at a time.

candidate_min_freq.help_text: Within-lineage presence-fraction cutoff a unitig must clear: 'core' (>=0.95), 'relaxed' (>=0.5), 'catchall' (>0.0), or a literal fraction e.g. '0.8'.

candidate_min_genome_count.help_text: Absolute lineage-genome-count floor, on top of candidate_min_freq. Also the size below which a sister lineage is ignored when computing specificity_max_outside.

specificity_max_outside.help_text: Ceiling on the MAX presence fraction across any single other lineage (not a pooled average across all of them -- that hides a unitig concentrated in one sister lineage). null = not applied, i.e. core-only. 0.05 (the PAT-3570 default) also requires lineage-specificity.

sbwt_diff_low_ram.help_text: Pass --low-ram to 'sbwt difference' for the bg_excl and markers diffs. Trades speed for lower peak RAM; not a correctness setting.

bg_index.help_text: Pre-built background SBWT index (ATB) that bg_excl / markers are diffed against when --bg_excl_index isn't set. Must be built at the same --color_index_kmer_size as the rest of this pipeline's indexes.

bg_excl_index.help_text: Path to an already-built bg_excl (background - species_index) SBWT index to reuse directly, skipping the hugemem-scale --bg_index diff. Leave empty to compute bg_excl from --bg_index instead.

publish_intermediate.help_text: Publish the per-stage intermediates (GGCAT unitigs, SBWT indexes, checkpoint count rows). false = keep only the final outputs; flip on to inspect a run.
